title: Double perpendicular of a subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $A$ be a linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $ bf_2$. With orthogonality defined by the standard dot product over $ bf_2$, the subspace perpendicular to the subspace perpendicular to $A$ is $A$ itself.
